sn22.83:2.1: Puṇṇa son of Mantāṇī was most famous for his conversation with Sāriputta in [mn24](), on the strength of which he was said to be the best Dhamma speaker ([an1.196]()). His verse is at [thag1.4:1.7](). For his mother’s name, see note on [mn86:12.12]().
sn22.83:4.3: Note the equality in terms of address: a newly ordained monk and their teacher refer to each other as “reverend” (_āvuso_).
